purpose: Unified additive scaffold for Module -> Practice -> Tool Task -> Evidence -> Review -> Rework -> Validation. It consolidates the existing source-backed v2/v3 work without rewriting, merging, deleting, or replacing lesson content.
rules: Existing lesson content remains authoritative and immutable.
Practice must link to existing lessonIds and skillIds when defined; unknown mappings remain explicit gaps.
Tool tasks use figma, framer, or none only where supported by the curriculum architecture.
Evidence must be observable and submitted before capability validation.
Review must produce an evidence-based decision; rework is used when required.
Validation confirms demonstrated capability and does not equal lesson completion.
Do not invent source lessons or silently fill identified curriculum gaps.

modules.title: Heuristics and Evidence-Based UX Evaluation

practice.activity: Inspect an interface against usability principles and turn concrete evidence into actionable findings.

toolTask.task: Evaluate a Figma/Framer screen or flow; record issue, evidence, affected users/context, principle and recommendation.

criteria: Learner can perform a systematic heuristic evaluation without treating it as a substitute for user research.

humanDecisionPoints: Review evidence and decide whether demonstrated capability is sufficient.
Do not treat lesson completion as capability validation.
